source_title: Fed leaves interest rates unchanged despite inflation in the US - Al Jazeera
source_excerpt:
The United States Federal Reserve is set to hold interest rates steady in its final monetary policy decision before the US midterm elections.
The central bank will maintain rates at 3.75-4 percent, following a 10-2 vote, in line with expectations.

CME FedWatch, which tracks the likelihood of monetary policy decisions, indicated that there was more than a 90 percent chance rates would remain unchanged.
“Economic activity is expanding at a strong pace,” the Fed said in its press release announcing the decision on Wednesday. “While uncertainty remains elevated owing, in part, to geopolitical developments, domestic spending has been resilient. Productivity growth is strong, and capital investment is robust. Job gains have kept pace with the workforce, and the unemployment rate has changed little.”
The Fed noted how inflation continues to rise.
It also added, “The accumulation of more information will help the Committee determine the policy stance appropriate to ensure a timely return of inflation to the Committee’s 2 percent goal.”
The most recent Consumer Price Index (CPI) report showed the annual inflation rate increasing to 3.7 percent in September , up from 3.4 percent in August, with energy prices largely accounting for the monthly surge.
There were signs earlier this month that the central bank would maintain benchmark interest rates, with the Fed’s chair for supervision, Michelle Bowman, advocating a “wait and see” approach.
“I don’t feel any urgency for taking further action at this point,” she said at this month’s International Monetary Fund-World Bank meetings in Bangkok, Thailand. “We really need to take some time and understand how things will evolve.”
The decision comes before Thursday’s release of the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) Price Index report, which is used by the central bank to assess inflation and inform its decisions.
Today’s Fed announcement follows an interest-rate hike rise last month, amid surging inflation – the first increase by the central bank since July 2023. The move drew criticism from US President Donald Trump, who has repeatedly pressed the Fed to cut rates since taking office. At the time, he wrote on Truth Social that “interest rates in the United States should be 1% or less.”
The Fed’s next monetary policy meeting is scheduled for December 8-9, when it will give its final rate decision of the year.
Current forecasts point to a quarter-point interest rate increase.
hi_body:
अमेरिकी फेडरल रिजर्व ने ब्याज दरों को 3.75-4 प्रतिशत की वर्तमान सीमा पर स्थिर रखने का निर्णय लिया है। 10-2 के मत से लिया गया यह निर्णय अमेरिकी मध्यावधि चुनावों से ठीक पहले आया है। यह कदम बाजार की उन अपेक्षाओं के अनुरूप है, जिसमें CME फेडवॉच टूल ने दरों में बदलाव न होने की 90 प्रतिशत संभावना जताई थी।

## आर्थिक परिदृश्य
केंद्रीय बैंक ने अपने आधिकारिक बयान में कहा कि भू-राजनीतिक अनिश्चितता के बावजूद घरेलू अर्थव्यवस्था लचीली बनी हुई है। फेड के मुख्य अवलोकन इस प्रकार हैं:
*   **आर्थिक गतिविधि:** विस्तार तेज गति से जारी है।
*   **व्यय और विकास:** घरेलू खर्च मजबूत है, और पूंजी निवेश तथा उत्पादकता वृद्धि में तेजी बनी हुई है।
*   **श्रम बाजार:** रोजगार में वृद्धि कार्यबल के साथ तालमेल बिठा रही है और बेरोजगारी दर में कोई बड़ा बदलाव नहीं आया है।

## मुद्रास्फीति की चिंताएं
इन सकारात्मक संकेतकों के बावजूद, फेड ने रेखांकित किया कि मुद्रास्फीति लगातार बढ़ रही है। हालिया उपभोक्ता मूल्य सूचकांक (CPI) रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, वार्षिक मुद्रास्फीति दर अगस्त के 3.4 प्रतिशत से बढ़कर सितंबर में 3.7 प्रतिशत हो गई, जिसका मुख्य कारण ऊर्जा की कीमतों में उछाल है।

## नीतिगत रुख
समिति ने 2 प्रतिशत के मुद्रास्फीति लक्ष्य को प्राप्त करने के लिए और अधिक डेटा जुटाने पर जोर दिया है। यह दृष्टिकोण फेड की पर्यवेक्षण अध्यक्ष मिशेल बोमन द्वारा पहले ही सुझाई गई 'प्रतीक्षा करें और देखें' की नीति के अनुरूप है।

फेडरल रिजर्व की अगली बैठक 8-9 दिसंबर को निर्धारित है, जो वर्ष का अंतिम नीतिगत निर्णय होगा। वर्तमान अनुमानों के अनुसार, उस बैठक में एक चौथाई प्रतिशत की ब्याज दर वृद्धि की संभावना है। यह निर्णय पर्सनल कंजम्पशन एक्सपेंडिचर (PCE) मूल्य सूचकांक रिपोर्ट के प्रकाशन से पहले आया है, जो भविष्य के मौद्रिक निर्णयों के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण मानक है।

hi_meta: अमेरिकी फेडरल रिजर्व ने मध्यावधि चुनावों से पहले बढ़ती महंगाई के बीच ब्याज दरों को 3.75-4 प्रतिशत पर स्थिर रखा है।
en_body:
The United States Federal Reserve has announced its decision to maintain interest rates at the current range of 3.75-4 percent. This choice, supported by a 10-2 vote, arrives ahead of the upcoming US midterm elections and aligns with broad market expectations, as reflected by the CME FedWatch tool, which had predicted a 90 percent probability of a pause.

## Economic Outlook
In its official statement, the central bank acknowledged that while geopolitical uncertainty persists, the underlying economy remains resilient. Key observations from the Fed include:
*   **Economic Activity:** Expansion continues at a strong pace.
*   **Spending and Growth:** Domestic spending remains firm, supported by robust capital investment and strong productivity growth.
*   **Labor Market:** Job growth is keeping pace with the labor force, and the unemployment rate remains stable.

## Inflation Concerns
Despite these positive indicators, the Fed highlighted that inflation continues to trend upward. The latest Consumer Price Index (CPI) report recorded an annual inflation rate of 3.7 percent in September, rising from 3.4 percent in August. This surge is largely attributed to rising energy prices.

## Policy Stance
The Committee emphasized the need for further data gathering to determine the appropriate policy stance to reach its 2 percent inflation target. This approach reflects the 'wait and see' strategy previously advocated by Michelle Bowman, the Fed's chair for supervision. 

Looking ahead, the Federal Reserve is scheduled to meet again on December 8-9 for its final policy decision of the year. Current market forecasts suggest the possibility of a quarter-point rate increase at that time. This decision precedes the upcoming release of the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) Price Index report, which is a critical metric for future monetary adjustments.
en_title: Federal Reserve Holds Interest Rates Steady Amid Persistent Inflation
en_meta: The US Federal Reserve has kept interest rates at 3.75-4 percent, citing economic resilience despite rising inflation ahead of the midterm elections.
